Subject: Audit-driven deployment options — CardioAI

Elena,

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap from our call and a proposed path forward so your security and procurement teams have clear options.

Key constraints you shared:
- PHI in scope for a subset of inference traffic (EHR data passed in prompts)
- CardioAI needs BAA and monthly audit evidence for SOC 2 controls
- Preference to avoid long procurement cycles if possible; latency requirements are 60–120ms p95

Deployment options we discussed (high level):
1) Hosted API (fastest): Redwood hosted with BAA addendum. Pros: fastest time-to-value, continuous model updates. Cons: shared infra; we'll provide scoped SOC2 extracts but not full dedicated isolation.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity): Dedicated GPU pool in our cloud with customer tenanting. Pros: predictable throughput, stronger isolation, we can provide expanded audit artifacts. Cons: 4–6 week provisioning + reservation commit.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): Full private control plane, can be placed in your VPC or on-prem. Pros: maximum compliance posture and auditability. Cons: longer lead time and higher Ops involvement.

Action items I propose:
- I'll attach an evidence mapping (controls → what Redwood can provide) and a draft BAA we typically share.
- Monica will join a short follow-up with your security lead to run through the evidence mapping (30 min).
- Karthik to scope latency testing & dedicated capacity sizing if you choose Dedicated.

Can you confirm who on your end should be on the security call and preferred windows next week (Mon/Tue afternoons PT)? Also confirm whether you'd like us to prepare an initial BAA redline vs full signature-ready BAA.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin

Elena — perfect, we've penciled Tue 22 Jun 2027 13:30 PT and I'll send an invite after this note.

Quick answers:
1) Hosted + BAA: we can provide artifact-level evidence for the following SOC 2 areas: system and communication protections (audit logs), access controls (user account & role reviews, MFA enforcement records), vulnerability management (scan summaries and remediation timelines), and change management (release notes & deployment approvals). I'll mark specifics in the attached mapping.
2) Dedicated reservation: minimum 3-month reservation for pilot (monthly billing available), typical enterprise commit is 12 months. Bursting: we support automated burst to our hosted pools for short-lived spikes; traffic routed to hosted will be covered under the same BAA terms for data in motion, but you should confirm with your procurement if shared-hosting during bursts is acceptable.

Next steps (I'll take the following before the Tue call):
- Send calendar invite + dial-in (Marcus)
- Monica: prep a concise evidence pack with sample artifacts for the controls we called out (Monica)
- Karthik: prepare a draft sizing and latency test plan for a dedicated pilot (Karthik)
